Beginner.learningGoal: Throw and catch typed errors with do/catch and try.
gotchas: try? discards the error and returns nil, losing information
A catch-all must come last or earlier patterns are shadowed
A function that throws needs a test for the thrown error (the specific case) and one for the success path; an uncaught throw in a test fails it with the error instead of an assertion
goodSolutionShows: An Error enum with meaningful cases and associated values
do/catch with specific cases before a general catch
throws signatures only on functions that can fail
shapeHints: validating a sign-up form with distinct errors
parsing a config line into key and value

Intermediate.learningGoal: Convert between throws and Result, use rethrows and try? / try! deliberately.
gotchas: Result(catching:) and get() bridge the two styles
rethrows only throws if the closure throws
map and flatMap on Result vs mapError
goodSolutionShows: Result for stored outcomes and throws for control flow
Collecting multiple outcomes without losing failures
shapeHints: running a batch of parse operations and returning both successes and failures
wrapping a throwing loader in Result
translating a storage error into a domain error

Advanced.learningGoal: Design error hierarchies, error wrapping and recovery with retries and typed throws awareness.
gotchas: Errors captured in async closures cross suspension points
Retry logic must not retry non-transient errors
Swift 6 typed throws vs untyped throws in the signature
goodSolutionShows: Domain errors with underlying cause (LocalizedError conformance)
Retry helper with injected attempt count and no real delay
shapeHints: a retry wrapper with an injected sleeper
aggregating validation errors into one composite error
a fallible pipeline that reports which stage failed
